originalRun.failure: All eight file/lock controls failed on macOS ARM64 while reopening a newly created lock file, with EACCES.
originalRun.diagnosis: POSIX open and fcntl were incorrectly bound as fixed-arity functions. Darwin ARM64 passes unnamed arguments on the stack. The corrected bindings use explicit variadic types; no permission or lock assertion was removed.

localControl.sandboxAttempt: The first attempt passed 11 controls but could not create a loopback socket under the restricted sandbox (EPERM); rerun with authorized loopback access passed all 12.
